# FastAgent

> FastAgent is the serving layer for local agent directories. It takes a directory out of the terminal and turns it into a running agent service: embedded in an app, connected to Telegram, Slack or Feishu, handling webhook events, running on a clock, or behind a custom channel. The harness is pi-durable; models come from pi-ai, with your own providers in code.

Key facts:

- Install: `npm i -g @fastagent-sh/fastagent` (CLI) or `npm i @fastagent-sh/fastagent` (library). Requires Node >= 24.15 (or Bun >= 1.4).
- An agent is a directory of its own, marked by `fastagent.config.ts` (`defineAgent`): `SYSTEM.md` (its prompt), `AGENTS.md`, `skills/`, `prompts/`, and code under `src/tools/`, `src/extensions/`, `src/channels/`, `src/schedules/`. What it works on is declared in `context.json` as its content. No build step.
- The contract is the Agent API (docs/SPEC.md), TypeScript in process: sessions the Agent names, messages whose outcome outlives their callers, a durable history. A serve exposes no HTTP API: only its channels' routes, which verify their platform.
- Core CLI: `fastagent init | info | content | env | models | login | dev | invoke | schedules | start | add | deploy | logs | destroy`. A coding agent checks an agent with `fastagent info --json`, `fastagent invoke` (`--json` for its events, `--session` to continue a conversation) and `fastagent schedules run`.
- Channels: Telegram, Slack, Feishu/Lark, plus custom adapters.

- [AI-guided start](https://fastagent.sh/start.md): executable instructions for a coding agent.
- [Documentation index](https://fastagent.sh/docs/): the full documentation map.

## Guides

- [Overview](https://fastagent.sh/docs/overview/): what FastAgent is and is not.
- [Quickstart](https://fastagent.sh/docs/quickstart/): scaffold, check, add a tool, and run.
- [Configuration](https://fastagent.sh/docs/configuration/): model, providers, auth, ports, tools, channels, and schedules.
- [CLI reference](https://fastagent.sh/docs/cli/): every command and flag.
- [Embedding](https://fastagent.sh/docs/embedding/): use FastAgent as a library inside your own app.
- [Channels](https://fastagent.sh/docs/channels/): add webhook/bot channels.
- [Telegram channel](https://fastagent.sh/docs/telegram/): Telegram bot.
- [Channel development](https://fastagent.sh/docs/channel-development/): build a custom channel adapter.
- [Deploy](https://fastagent.sh/docs/deploy/): ship the directory to Fly, Railway, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, or any Docker host.
- [Troubleshooting](https://fastagent.sh/docs/troubleshooting/): common setup/runtime issues.
